records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net sales in the three months ended December 31, 2024 were $234,138,000, a decrease of $20,005,000 or 7.9% from the three months ended December 31, 2023 net sales of $254,143,000.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net sales were positively impacted by $2,333,000 due to price increases, offset by $21,295,000 of unfavorable sales volume.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Foreign currency translation unfavorably impacted sales by $1,043,000 for the three months ended December 31, 2024.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Our principal raw materials and components purchases were approximately $396 million in fiscal 2024 (or 62% of Cost of product sold) and include steel, consisting of rod, wire, bar, structural, and other forms of steel; electric motors; bearings; gear reducers; castings; steel and aluminum enclosures and wire harnesses; electro-mechanical components; and standard variable drives and controls.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net cash provided by operating activities was $10,000,000 for the nine months ended December 31, 2024 compared to $28,591,000 for the nine months ended December 31, 2023.
